rows.note: This is the all-purpose way to refer to the person currently holding an office or title, such as 現任議員 or 現任校長.

example.english: The incumbent legislator for that district says they will continue serving local residents.
example.traditional: 嗰區嘅現任議員話會繼續為街坊服務。
example.jyutping: go2 keoi1 ge3 jin6 jam6 ji5 jyun4 waa6 wui5 gai3 zuk6 wai6 gaai1 fong1 fuk6 mou6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone who currently holds an office or title.

example.english: They are the incumbent principal of the school and have held the post for three years.
example.traditional: 佢係學校嘅現任校長，做咗三年喇。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 hok6 haau6 ge3 jin6 jam6 haau6 zoeng2 zou6 zo2 saam1 nin4 laa3

rows.note: Use this when the obligation is placed on a person or group.

example.english: As the estate management company, it is incumbent on them to follow up on this complaint.
example.traditional: 作為屋苑管理公司，佢哋有責任跟進呢單投訴。
example.jyutping: zok3 wai4 uk1 jyun2 gun2 lei5 gung1 si1 keoi5 dei6 jau5 zaak3 jam6 gan1 zeon3 ne1 daan1 tau4 sou3

rows.note: Use this when focusing on the action that is obligatory rather than on who bears the duty.

example.english: To protect patients' safety, it is incumbent on nurses to follow this procedure.
example.traditional: 為咗保障病人安全，護士必須跟足呢套程序。
example.jyutping: wai6 zo2 bou2 zoeng3 beng6 jan4 on1 cyun4 wu6 si6 bit1 seoi1 gan1 zuk1 ne1 tou3 cing4 zeoi6
